B Service Law: Railway Protection Force Act, 1967-Section 9(1)-Railway Protection Force Rules, 1959-Rules 44, 104, 147 and 156(b)(iii)-Disciplinary C proceedings-Charge of absence from duty without proper intimation­ Punishment of removal from service-Punishment held to be disproportionate, by of a request for leave, which is not accepted is not a proper intimation-The scope of interference with punishment awarded by D a disciplinary authority is very limited and unless the punishment is shockingly disproportionate the Court cannot interfere with the same-It is for the employee to show
